nodes.description: address owner; privileged contract owner set in constructor and receiver of 10% fee
mapping(address => uint8[]) playerCountries; per-player list of owned country IDs
address[178] ownerofCountry; fixed-size map of country to current owner
address[] playerList; array of all participants, cleared on game end
uint256 totalmoney; accumulated pot distributed at game end
uint256 lastR; last attack outcome derived from block.blockhash
address lastgameendWinner; recorded winner of the previous game
uint8 winnerLimit; number of countries required to win the game
address[15] winnerloser; rolling history of attackers, defenders and result codes
constructor Risk(); assigns owner = msg.sender
payable buyCountry(uint8); mints country ownership, tracks funds and player list
attackCountry(uint8); resolves battle using blockhash randomness and transfers countries
isGameEnd(); checks winner limit, pays out pot and resets all game state
setwinnerLimit(uint8); owner-only mutation of winnerLimit via assert(msg.sender==owner)
constant view returning ownerofCountry array
constant view returning totalmoney
constant getaddr(address,uint8); indexes playerCountries[ax][bx]
constant len(address); returns playerCountries[ax].length
constant lastrandom(); exposes the blockhash-derived lastR value
constant getwinnerloser(); returns winnerloser history array
constant lastgamewinner(); returns lastgameendWinner
External caller identity used for ownership, attacks and the owner-only guard
Unchecked payable accumulation totalmoney += msg.value with no SafeMath
winner.transfer(totalmoney/10*9); external ETH call to a player-controlled address
owner.transfer(totalmoney/10); external ETH call executed before state cleanup
Pseudo-randomness from block.blockhash(block.number-1) mod (a+b); miner influenceable
Bulk unchecked reset loops over ownerofCountry, playerCountries and winnerloser

normalization_plan.reason: countryID is an input parameter bound directly to the buyCountry entry point and carries no independent semantics
countryID is only used to index ownerofCountry inside attackCountry and should be folded into the function node
x is the sole input of setwinnerLimit and flows straight into the winnerLimit state variable
ax is a pure indexing parameter of the getaddr view and adds no separate data flow
bx is a pure indexing parameter of the getaddr view and adds no separate data flow
ax is the only parameter of len and maps directly onto the mapping lookup
attacker is a transient local assigned from msg.sender and used only inside attackCountry
defender is a transient local read from ownerofCountry and used only inside attackCountry
a is a temporary strength bucket computed and consumed inside attackCountry
b is a temporary strength bucket computed and consumed inside attackCountry
i is a loop counter local to attackCountry loops
loopcount is a transient loop bound local to attackCountry
winner is the local source of the payout recipient and therefore belongs to the external transfer operation
del is a transient boolean controlling the reset branch inside isGameEnd
